abilities.name: Tailwind
abilities.description: Gain 15% increased Movement Speed after not taking damage for 5 seconds.; 6; trait

abilities.name: Hammerang
abilities.description: Throw out a Hammer that returns to Falstad, dealing 80 damage and Slowing enemies by 25% for 2 seconds. Reactive to explode the hammer, dealing 95 damage to nearby enemies.

fields.props: Area of Effect, Clamping, Piercing Skillshot
fields.notes: Hammerang can hit a unit twice, once on both throw and return. Reactivation area damage does not apply the Slow.

abilities.name: Lightning Rod
abilities.description: Deal 107 to an enemy, and an additional 75 damage per second for 3.75 seconds while close to the target. Deals 100% increased damage to Minions and Mercenaries.

fields.notes: Target is validated every 0.25 seconds. If the target is untargetable or outside the active radius during the check, the Ability ends. Target momentarily leaving the active radius or becoming untargetable does not end the Ability, as long as they are valid for the next check. Only one Lightning Rod may be active at a time. Recasting Lightning Rod on another Hero while it is still active causes only the initial damage to be dealt. Recasting Lightning Rod on the same Hero resets its duration. Damage bonus to Minions and Mercenaries stacks additively with other offensive damage modifiers affecting Lightning Rod 's damage.

abilities.name: Barrel Roll
abilities.description: Dashes forward and grants a 171 point Shield for 3 seconds.

abilities.name: Hinterland Blast
abilities.description: After 1 second, deal 475 damage to enemies within a long line. The cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds for every enemy Hero hit.; 120; 80; heroic

fields.props: Area of Effect, Channeled cast (stationary), Clamping
fields.notes: Interrupting the channel during its cast puts the ability on a 10 second cooldown.

abilities.name: Mighty Gust
abilities.description: Push enemies away, and Slow their Movement Speed by 40% decaying over 4 seconds.; 60; 70; heroic

fields.notes: Always pushes a set distance regardless of the distance between Falstad and the affected enemy.

abilities.name: Flight
abilities.description: Instead of mounting, Falstad can fly a great distance over terrain.

fields.notes: Cast can be canceled by issuing a 'move' or 'stop' command or be interrupted by enemy abilities that Stun, Silence, Stasis or Knockback. Taking damage does not interrupt the cast. Interrupting the channel in any way puts Flight on a 10 second cooldown. An indicator will display the landing location to both teams on the ground (for the enemy team, it only appears if within vision).

talents.name: Gathering Storm
talents.description: Quest Hit enemy Heroes with Hammerang. Restore 6 Mana for each Hero hit. Upon dying, lose 8 stacks. After hitting 30 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals 30% more damage. Reward After hitting 80 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 50% damage. Reward After hitting 150 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 70% damage.

fields.notes: Hammerang 's reactivation also grants stacks and benefits from the damage bonus. Continues to gain stacks after the quest reward is achieved. Per hit and reward damage bonuses stack additively with themselves and other offensive damage modifiers that can affect Hammerang 's damage.

Reward After hitting 80 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 50% damage. Reward After hitting 150 Heroes, Hammerang permanently deals an additional 70% damage.

talents.name: Dishonorable Discharge
talents.description: Quest After 3 Lightning Rod strikes, subsequent strikes on enemy Heroes increase its damage. After 20 subsequent strikes, gain 30% damage. Reward After 45 subsequent strikes, gain an additional 75% damage and reduce the cooldown by 2 seconds. Reward After 75 subsequent strikes, Lightning Rod provides 2 additional strikes and Stuns enemy Heroes for 1.25 seconds on its last strike.

fields.notes: Damage bonus affects both initial and periodic damage instances. Damage bonus stacks additively with itself and offensive damage modifiers that can affect Lightning Rod 's damage.

talents.name: Frequent Flyer
talents.description: Cooldown 60 Activate Frequent Flyer to gain 25% Attack Speed and Tailwind for 4 seconds. Quest Minion kills grant 1 stack. Hero Takedowns grant 5 stacks. After 60 stacks, gain 20 Attack Damage. Reward After 150 stacks, gain 50 additional Attack Damage. Reward After 300 stacks, gain 125 additional Attack Damage.

fields.notes: When Tailwind is activated through this talent, it cannot be interrupted by taking damage. Minions that die in any way within 8.5 radius of Falstad grant quest progress.
